steps.name: EbpfDataplane writes the applied-set fingerprint with the table and reads it back; inner capacity 16,383
steps.description: In overdrive-dataplane: split the Maglev table size (16,381, the XDP modulus) from the inner capacity as two constants (SERVICE_MAP_INNER_CAPACITY = 16,381 + 2 = 16,383); the inner prototype and every inner map carry 16,383 slots (kernel array_map_meta_equal rejects a mismatch, K-4). update_service with a non-empty set computes fingerprint(&frontend.vip, &backends) and writes its low 32 bits to inner slot 16,381 and high 32 bits to slot 16,382 of the NEW inner array before the atomic outer swap; an empty update deletes the outer slot as today. Correct every stale lockstep comment that names one value for both constants, the verifier_regress/verifier_budget text, and any fixture that builds an inner array for the production outer map (tests under crates/overdrive-dataplane/tests/integration/ and the overdrive-bpf Tier-2 xdp_service_map_lookup fixtures) to 16,383.

steps.name: The resync pass: resync_reconciler, the boot-anchored pass loop and the D-1c removals
steps.description: Replace the resync_reconciler scaffold (pub(crate) async fn resync_reconciler(state: &AppState, name: &ReconcilerName) -> Result<usize, HydrateError>) with the real step: call managed_targets through the production HydrationContext and submit ONE Immediate Evaluation per target through ReconcilerRuntime::submit_evaluation, or on Err submit none; return the count; writes no observation row. Wire the pass into the convergence loop (crate-private; name and visibility the crafter's): a loop over resync_reconciler for each registered reconciler in BTreeMap order, adding no other effect; on Err it logs a structured event naming reconciler and error and continues with the next reconciler (never aborts, never a partial set); it runs a pass at boot, then anchors the next pass at previous + 30 s constant (D-2) on the injected clock the convergence loop already reads (BootAdapters.clock / AppState.clock), re-armed at most once per period, no drift. Same-commit D-1c removals: Reconciler::resync_schedule, ResyncSchedule, ResyncScope, AnyReconciler::resync_schedule, build_cadence_table, the cadence phase (next-wake table and scope resolution), the vm-reclamation and gateway-svid-lifecycle overrides, INTEREST_ROUTER_RELIST_PERIOD and the periodic arm of the router; spawn_interest_router reverts to the pinned five-parameter signature (obs, subscription, interest_table, broker, shutdown); the boot LIST and the Lagged relist stay; the vm-reclamation boot-time evaluation drive stays unless shown redundant with the first pass. Delete the tests and acceptance fixtures that assert the removed items (tests/acceptance/cadence_resync.rs, the interest_router.rs periodic-relist tests, the resync_schedule assertions in reconciler_trait_surface.rs and any reconciler tests of the removed overrides) in the same commit. run_convergence_tick_inner control flow is unchanged (ADR-0321 decision 3). Land the D15 doc correction in the same commit (user ruling D-15): development.md Reconciler I/O replaces 'an unreadable observation is the runtime's to log-and-skip' with the hydrate-error-ends-the-evaluation text, documents next_evaluation_at and managed_targets beside resync_schedule's removal; reconcilers.md wakeup-model section drops 'never both' and states the pass as the backstop for every reconciler (text from the feature delta 'Proposed rule text').

steps.name: reconcilers.md: a View decides when to act, never whether an effect is in place
steps.description: In .claude/rules/reconcilers.md replace the fingerprint-shaped 'Symptoms during review' bullet with the general prohibition drafted in the feature delta 'Proposed rule text': the View may carry pacing inputs (attempts, last attempt time, retry budget, rate limit, a marker keyed to an observed input such as a probe row's run_seq) that decide only when to act again; it never decides whether an effect is in place, which is decided from actual read from the resource the reconciler manages; a marker keyed to an observed input suppresses re-emission only for that same input; if the effect cannot be observed, make it observable first (a result row of the last attempt is a receipt, not the resource). Add the listed symptoms (a View field consulted as the diff; a field stamped on emit and consulted to decide whether the effect is in place; a reconciler whose only wake is an edge; a managed-target method that enumerates one observation family only; a test or simulation invariant that seeds the View to represent converged instead of asserting on actual) and the 'every reconciler declares its managed targets' paragraph if 03-02 did not already land it. Correct the stale 'still live in tree' bullet about ServiceLifecycleView::last_emitted_backend_fingerprint (ADR-0101 deleted the field). The rule names no exception and is timeless: principle plus symptoms, no ADR-as-status, no 'resolved by' or DELIVER-phase notes. Edit exactly the instructed scope; do not remove neighbouring sections.
